threshold_calibration: Use the median optimal-date activity ratio across all informative 5,000 pre-pandemic pairs, rounded to the nearest 0.1 as specified in design.json.
fixed_week_calibration: Choose the candidate vaccination week maximizing mean utility across the same 5,000 pre-pandemic pairs. Resolve exact ties by the earliest seasonal candidate.
displayed_pre_pandemic_pairs: First 50 pairs of the seeded pre-pandemic simulation; no selection by optimal date, fit, or appearance.
evaluation: Apply both frozen policies to each post-pandemic pair and compare each with that pair's optimum. Report absolute timing gaps and relative modeled protection loss for both policies, including non-crossings.
stage_4_display: Align the 50 pre-pandemic profiles by maximum shared area after AUC normalization, then display activity divided by each draw's September baseline so that the learned activity threshold has the same meaning across curves.
stage_5_display: Show 50 post-pandemic profiles on a calendar axis with their own optima, threshold-triggered dates, and the fixed pre-pandemic week. Compare timing gaps, with modeled regret available in the evidence notes.
